environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed in Kubernetes namespace 'frontend' on GKE cluster. The service runs as a sidecar-injected Istio pod but the mesh is in PERMISSIVE mode with no AuthorizationPolicy resources applied. The pod's service account has no network policy restrictions. Cloud metadata endpoint is accessible via alternative IPs (e.g., metadata.google.internal resolves to 169.254.169.254 but DNS-based access bypasses the hardcoded IP blocklist). Envoy sidecar passes all traffic without authorization checks.
